content_review.notes: English and Chinese were compared section by section; numbers, ranges, qualifiers, species names, conservation scope and source support were checked.

conservation_status.note_en: The 2020 IUCN assessment reports a decreasing population and an estimated decline of at least 80% over three generations.
conservation_status.note_zh: IUCN 2020年评估认为其种群仍在下降，并推测三个世代内的降幅至少达到80%。

description.en: The red ruffed lemur is a large, fruit-loving lemur found naturally only in the forests of Madagascar's Masoala Peninsula. Its rusty-red coat, black face and tail, and small white patch behind the head make it easy to recognize. By carrying pollen and spreading swallowed seeds, it also helps its rainforest renew itself. Habitat loss, hunting, logging and powerful cyclones have left the species Critically Endangered.
description.zh: 红领狐猴是一种体型较大、喜食果实的狐猴，野外仅自然分布于马达加斯加的马苏阿拉半岛森林。它有赤褐色体毛、黑色面部与尾巴，后颈通常还有一小块白斑，十分醒目。它会携带花粉、传播吞下的种子，帮助雨林更新。栖息地丧失、狩猎、伐木和强烈气旋使它成为极危物种。

anatomy.en: Most of the body is covered in thick rusty-red fur, while the face, belly, hands, feet and tail are black; a white patch often marks the back of the neck. Adults can weigh up to about 4.1 kilograms, and published measurements put total length at roughly 110–120 centimeters including the long tail. Like other lemurs, it has a toothcomb and a grooming claw that help keep its dense coat clean.
anatomy.zh: 它的大部分身体覆盖着浓密的赤褐色毛，面部、腹部、手、脚和尾巴为黑色，后颈常有一块白斑。成年个体体重可达约4.1千克，已有测量显示其含长尾在内的总长约为110–120厘米。和其他狐猴一样，它具有梳状齿与梳爪，可以帮助清理浓密的毛发。

ecology_and_behavior.en: Red ruffed lemurs are active by day and spend most of their time in the forest canopy. Fruit makes up most of their diet, supplemented by leaves, seeds and nectar. Their flexible communities split into smaller foraging parties when food is scattered, then gather more widely when food is plentiful. Loud calls and scent marks help separated animals stay in contact and signal that an area is occupied.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 红领狐猴白天活动，大部分时间生活在森林冠层。它们主要吃果实，也会取食叶片、种子和花蜜。食物分散时，灵活的群体会拆分成较小的觅食小队；食物丰富时，更多成员又会聚在一起。响亮的叫声和气味标记能帮助分散的成员保持联系，也能表示某片区域已被占用。

habitat_and_distribution.en: This species is native only to northeastern Madagascar, especially the forests of the Masoala Peninsula near Maroantsetra. It usually uses the upper canopy of tropical forest. The Antainambalana River helps separate its range from that of the closely related black-and-white ruffed lemur. Because no verified range geometry is stored in this project, the map shows a representative center point rather than a guessed boundary.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 该物种仅原生于马达加斯加东北部，主要生活在马鲁安采特拉附近的马苏阿拉半岛森林中，通常活动于热带森林的上层林冠。安泰南巴拉纳河在地理上帮助分隔红领狐猴与近亲黑白领狐猴的分布。本项目尚未保存经过核实的分布边界，因此地图只显示代表性中心点，不绘制猜测范围。

value.en: Mostly fruit; also leaves, seeds and nectar
value.zh: 以果实为主，也吃叶、种子和花蜜

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: Breeding usually takes place in months 5–7 (May to July). After a gestation of roughly 90–120 days, a female commonly gives birth to 3 young, although litters can be larger. The mother builds a leafy nest and leaves the young safely parked there while adults forage, rather than carrying them continuously as many primates do. Young red ruffed lemurs reach sexual maturity at about 2 years of age.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 繁殖通常发生在5月至7月。经过约90–120天的妊娠期后，雌性通常产下3只幼崽，但也可能更多。母亲会用叶片筑巢，成年个体外出觅食时将幼崽安全地留在巢中，而不像许多灵长类那样一直背着幼崽。红领狐猴大约在2岁时达到性成熟。

detail.en: Its unusually thick coat helps protect it in the wet rainforest canopy, much like a raincoat rather than a winter coat.
detail.zh: 它异常浓密的皮毛有助于抵挡湿润林冠中的雨水，更像一件雨衣，而不是御寒冬衣。

detail.en: A toothcomb in the lower jaw and a grooming claw on the foot work like a comb for cleaning thick fur.
detail.zh: 下颌的梳状齿与脚上的梳爪就像梳子，可以清理浓密毛发。

detail.en: Parking several young in a nest lets the mother move through the canopy to find enough fruit for the energy-demanding nursing period.
detail.zh: 把多只幼崽留在巢中，可以让母亲在林冠中移动觅食，为高耗能的哺乳期取得足够果实。

ecological_role.en: Red ruffed lemurs help maintain rainforest plant communities in two ways. Pollen sticks to the fur around the face while they drink nectar and can be carried to another flower. They also swallow seeds with fruit and deposit them elsewhere in natural fertilizer, allowing some large-seeded plants to spread away from the parent tree.
ecological_role.zh: 红领狐猴通过两种方式帮助维持雨林植物群落。它们吸食花蜜时，花粉会粘在面部周围的毛上，并被带到下一朵花。它们还会连同果肉吞下种子，再把种子随天然“肥料”排到别处，使一些大种子植物能够远离母树扩散。

threats.en: Forest is cleared or damaged by agriculture and illegal logging, while hunting and live capture add direct pressure. Because the species has a narrow range, severe tropical cyclones can affect a large part of its remaining habitat at once.
threats.zh: 农业开垦和非法伐木会清除或破坏森林，狩猎与活体捕捉又带来直接压力。由于分布范围狭窄，强烈热带气旋可能一次影响其大面积剩余栖息地。

actions.en: Priorities include protecting and reconnecting Masoala forest, enforcing controls on hunting and illegal logging, monitoring wild populations, and supporting nearby communities in conservation. Carefully managed populations in human care provide an additional safeguard, but they cannot replace habitat protection.
actions.zh: 保护重点包括守护并连接马苏阿拉森林、加强对狩猎与非法伐木的执法、持续监测野外种群，并支持周边社区参与保护。科学管理的人工饲养种群可以提供额外保障，但不能替代栖息地保护。

key_features.en: Look for a broad rusty-red or chestnut ruff and body, combined with a black face, belly, hands, feet and tail. A contrasting white patch is often visible on the back of the neck.
key_features.zh: 识别时可寻找宽大的赤褐色或栗色颈毛与体毛，同时注意黑色面部、腹部、手、脚和尾巴；后颈通常还能看到对比鲜明的白斑。

similar_species.en: The closest look-alike is the black-and-white ruffed lemur (Varecia variegata). It shares the black face, hands, feet and tail, but its body pattern is dominated by black and white rather than the red ruff and red body of V. rubra.
similar_species.zh: 最容易混淆的是黑白领狐猴（Varecia variegata）。两者都有黑色面部、手、脚和尾巴，但黑白领狐猴的身体以黑白花纹为主，不具有红领狐猴醒目的红色颈毛与红色身体。

communication_and_senses.en: Red ruffed lemurs use loud guttural barks, alarm calls and group choruses. Different alarm calls can carry information about danger, and calls help scattered foragers keep track of one another. Scent marks from glands near the rear add a chemical message that identifies groups and used areas.
communication_and_senses.zh: 红领狐猴会发出响亮的喉音吠叫、警报声和群体合唱。不同警报声可以传递危险信息，叫声还能让分散觅食的成员掌握彼此位置。后部气味腺留下的标记则提供化学信息，用来辨认群体和已使用的区域。

seasonal_calendar.en: Breeding is concentrated in months 5–7 (May to July), during Madagascar's drier season, and births follow after the short gestation. Social grouping also changes with food: larger gatherings are more common when wet-season foods are abundant, while animals divide into smaller foraging parties when resources are scattered.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 繁殖集中在5月至7月，即马达加斯加较干燥的季节，经过较短妊娠期后幼崽出生。群体规模也会随食物改变：雨季食物丰富时较容易形成较大聚集，资源分散时则拆分成较小觅食队伍。

relationship_with_humans.en: People are part of both the problem and the solution. Hunting, live capture and forest clearing threaten the species, while protected-area staff, Malagasy communities, researchers and responsible zoos work to protect habitat, study populations and maintain a carefully managed backup population. Seeing lemurs can also support nature tourism when it is managed responsibly.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 人类既可能造成威胁，也能成为解决方案的一部分。狩猎、活体捕捉和森林开垦危及该物种；保护区工作人员、马达加斯加社区、研究人员和负责任的动物园则共同保护栖息地、调查种群，并维持科学管理的后备种群。管理得当的观狐猴活动也能支持自然旅游。

evolution.en: Red ruffed lemurs belong to the lemur family Lemuridae and are one of two currently recognized species in the genus Varecia; the other is the black-and-white ruffed lemur. Older classifications treated the red form as a subspecies, Varecia variegata rubra, but it is now widely recognized as the species Varecia rubra. The two ruffed lemurs retain many shared features, including dense coats, loud calls and fruit-centered diets.
evolution.zh: 红领狐猴属于狐猴科，是领狐猴属目前公认的两个物种之一，另一个是黑白领狐猴。较旧的分类曾把红色类型视为亚种 Varecia variegata rubra，如今则广泛承认为独立物种 Varecia rubra。两种领狐猴仍保留许多共同特征，包括浓密皮毛、响亮叫声和以果实为中心的食性。

field_signs.en: In dense canopy, a red ruffed lemur may be heard before it is seen: groups produce carrying barks and rough choruses. Fresh scent marks on frequently used branches and leafy nests holding young can also reveal their presence, although nests should never be approached or disturbed.
field_signs.zh: 在茂密林冠中，人们可能先听见红领狐猴，再看到它们：群体会发出传得很远的吠声和粗哑合唱。常用树枝上的新鲜气味标记，以及安置幼崽的叶巢，也可能透露它们的存在；但绝不应靠近或干扰巢穴。

text.en: Ruffed lemurs are unusual among primates because females can raise a litter instead of a single infant; they have six nipples and can nurse several young at once.
text.zh: 领狐猴在灵长类中很特别：雌性可以一次养育一窝幼崽，而不只是单只幼崽；它们有六个乳头，可以同时哺育多只幼崽。

text.en: When a ruffed lemur drinks nectar, pollen can cling to the fluffy ruff around its face, turning the animal into one of the world's largest pollinators.
text.zh: 领狐猴吸食花蜜时，花粉会粘在面部周围蓬松的颈毛上，使它成为世界上体型最大的传粉动物之一。

text.en: Large ruffed lemurs can swallow surprisingly large seeds; Duke Lemur Center notes that seeds up to about 4 centimeters long can pass through and be deposited elsewhere.
text.zh: 大型领狐猴能够吞下相当大的种子；杜克狐猴中心指出，长达约4厘米的种子也能通过消化道并被带到别处。

content.en: A community does not always travel as one unit. Individuals form smaller foraging parties whose membership and size change with season and food supply, while calls help keep the wider network connected.
content.zh: 一个群体并不总是作为整体行动。成员会组成规模和成员随季节、食物供应改变的小型觅食队伍，再用叫声维持更大社会网络的联系。

content.en: Instead of carrying newborns everywhere, a mother builds a nest and parks her litter there. Other community members may help watch the young, an uncommon care system among primates.
content.zh: 母亲不会把新生幼崽一直带在身上，而是筑巢并把一窝幼崽留在那里。其他群体成员也可能帮助看护幼崽，这在灵长类中并不常见。

habitat.text_en: Tropical forests of the Masoala Peninsula in northeastern Madagascar, mainly in the upper canopy.
habitat.text_zh: 马达加斯加东北部马苏阿拉半岛的热带森林，主要活动于上层林冠。

range_review.comparison_en: The previous hand-drawn polygon had no traceable geometry source and was removed during the 2026-08-16 review. IUCN and institutional sources confirm the northeastern Madagascar and Masoala Peninsula range, but verified coordinates have not yet been imported, so the map shows a representative point at regional zoom rather than a distribution boundary.
range_review.comparison_zh: 2026-08-16复审时发现旧手绘多边形没有可追溯的几何数据来源，因此将其移除。IUCN及机构来源支持其分布于马达加斯加东北部和马苏阿拉半岛，但项目尚未导入经过核实的边界坐标，所以地图以区域缩放显示一个代表点，而不把它冒充为完整分布范围。
